subject: ela
cluster: Range of Reading and Level of Text Complexity
intro: Read each passage and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

He gave away his fortune and died content in a bare room.

A theme is:
A) wealth isn't fulfillment
B) always hoard money
C) rooms matter most

Read.

The wind argued with the shutters all night.

This is:
A) personification
B) a fact
C) a summary

To support an interpretation of a text, use:
A) the strongest textual evidence
B) a guess
C) the cover price

Read.

The preacher condemned greed, then passed the gilded collection plate twice.

The author's tone is:
A) ironic/critical
B) admiring
C) neutral

Read.

'Oh good, another meeting,' he sighed.

This is:
A) verbal irony (sarcasm)
B) a sincere statement
C) a metaphor

Read.

A soldier gains honor but loses his innocence.

Two themes here are:
A) honor and the loss of innocence
B) only that soldiers are brave
C) only that wars are long
items.answer: A) honor and the loss of innocence

steps: Two interacting themes. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) honor and the loss of innocence

items.prompt:
Read.

The narrator insists he is 'the most honest man alive,' just after we watch him forge a signature.

The narrator is best described as:
A) reliable
B) unreliable
C) omniscient

steps: His claim contradicts his act. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

An essay, straight-faced, proposes selling the moon to pay off the national debt.

This is:
A) satire, using an absurd proposal to criticize
B) a serious policy plan
C) a science report
items.answer: A) satire, using an absurd proposal to criticize

steps: Absurd proposal = satire. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) satire, using an absurd proposal to criticize
